POST /v1/auth/signup.description: Creates a person's account (not yet in any organization). Passwords need at least 10 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number. Three different security questions are required; they are used to recover the account later. Some deployments only accept work email addresses.

request.name: string, required. Display name, up to 120 characters
request.password: string, required. At least 10 characters with upper case, lower case and a number

quiz.question: string, required. One of three different security questions
quiz.answer: string, required. At least 2 characters; compared without case or extra spaces

errors.400: Missing name, weak password, or the three security questions are not three different answered ones
errors.403: domain_not_allowed: this deployment only accepts certain email domains
errors.409: email_in_use: an account with this email already exists

POST /v1/auth/login.description: Exchange an email and password for an access token and a refresh token. Send `org` (the organization's slug) to get a token for that organization, which every organization route needs; leave it out to get an account-level token plus the list of organizations the person belongs to. If two-step sign-in is on, a first call without `totp` fails with `mfa_required`; repeat it with the 6-digit code. Repeated wrong passwords from one address, or on one account, lock sign-in for a while.

request.totp: string. 6-digit authenticator code, when two-step sign-in is on
request.org: string. Organization slug to sign in to

response.access_token: string. Bearer token, valid for `expires_in` seconds
response.expires_in: integer. Seconds the access token lives
response.name: string. Display name

org.name: string
org.person: uuid. This account's person id inside the organization

response.must_change_password: boolean. True after an administrator reset: send the person to change it before anything else

errors.401: invalid_credentials: email or password is wrong; mfa_required: send the authenticator code
errors.403: account_<status>: the account is suspended or disabled; not_a_member: no access to that organization; no_profile: not placed in the organization yet
errors.429: account_locked: too many wrong attempts; try again later

POST /v1/auth/refresh.description: Refresh tokens are single use: every answer carries the next one. Presenting a refresh token that was already used signs that whole session out. Use `org` to move to another organization without signing in again.

response.refresh_token: string. Use this one next time
response.name: string

errors.401: The refresh token is invalid, expired or was already used

POST /v1/auth/logout.description: Ends the current session. The access and refresh tokens stop working.

POST /v1/auth/active.summary: Report that the person is using the app
POST /v1/auth/active.description: Call when the person clicks or types (not from background polling). Keeps the session from timing out for inactivity.

response.idle_minutes: integer. The organization's inactivity limit in minutes; 0 means no limit

GET /v1/auth/session.summary: How long until the session times out
GET /v1/auth/session.description: Reads the inactivity clock without counting as activity.

response.seconds_left: integer. Seconds until sign-out; -1 when there is no limit

POST /v1/auth/password.description: Other sessions of the account are signed out. The new password follows the same rules as sign-up.

errors.400: wrong_password: the current password is not right; or the new one is too weak

POST /v1/auth/mfa/setup.description: Returns a new authenticator secret. It is not active until confirmed with POST /v1/auth/mfa/confirm.

response.secret: string. Base32 secret to type into an authenticator app
response.otpauth_url: string. otpauth:// URL for a QR code

POST /v1/auth/mfa/confirm.description: Confirms the secret with a code from the authenticator. From then on sign-in needs `totp`.

request.code: string, required. 6-digit code from the authenticator

POST /v1/auth/reset/start.summary: Forgot password, step 1: send a code
POST /v1/auth/reset/start.description: Emails a 6-digit code to the address if an account exists. The answer is the same whether or not it does, so it cannot be used to find out who has an account. Part of a four-step recovery: start, code, security questions, then a link that sets the new password.

response.reset_id: uuid. Keep it for the next steps

errors.429: Too many recovery attempts from this address

POST /v1/auth/reset/code.summary: Forgot password, step 2: enter the emailed code
POST /v1/auth/reset/code.description: On a correct code, returns the person's three security questions.

request.code: string, required. The 6-digit code from the email

questions: string. A security question the person chose at sign-up

errors.400: invalid_code: the code is not right or has expired

POST /v1/auth/reset/quiz.summary: Forgot password, step 3: answer the security questions
POST /v1/auth/reset/quiz.description: On correct answers a link is emailed to set the new password.

answers: string, required. Answers in the same order as the questions

response.sent: boolean. true: the link was emailed

errors.400: invalid_answers: one or more answers are wrong

POST /v1/auth/reset/complete.summary: Forgot password, step 4: set the new password
POST /v1/auth/reset/complete.description: Uses the token from the emailed link and a code.

request.token: string, required. From the emailed link
request.code: string, required. Code from the email
request.new_password: string, required. Same rules as sign-up

errors.400: invalid_link: the link was already used or has expired; invalid_code
